Calculate UMAP embeddings across normalisation methods

Source: R/umap_runner.R
get_umap_data.Rd

Perform PCA and UMAP independently for each normalisation method using the same sampled spots and common genes.

Usage

get_umap_data(
  norm,
  methods = NULL,
  prop_spots = 1,
  seed = 123,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  n_pcs = 30,
  n_neighbors = 15
)

Arguments

norm

Named list of normalised SpatialExperiment objects.

methods

Character vector of methods to compare. If NULL, all available methods are used.

prop_spots

Proportion of spots to sample.

seed

Random seed.

assay_name

Assay used for PCA and UMAP.

n_pcs

Number of principal components.

n_neighbors

Number of UMAP neighbours.

Value

Data frame containing UMAP coordinates, method, spot identifiers, and all colData annotations.

Details

All colData annotations from the reference object are retained for subsequent plotting.

Examples

data(norm_example)

umap_data <- get_umap_data(
  norm_example,
  methods = NULL,
  prop_spots = 1,
  seed = 123,
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  n_pcs = 30,
  n_neighbors = 15
)
#> Running PCA and UMAP: None
#> Warning: You're computing too large a percentage of total singular values, use a standard svd instead.
#> Running PCA and UMAP: SpaNorm
